_metadata.description: Blind question set (no answers/sources) paired with eval_ground_truth_waymo.json by question_id, mirroring eval_questions_blind.json's shape.

questions.question_text: How many scenes does the Waymo Open Dataset used in this paper's experiments contain, and how is it split into training, validation, and test sets?
What similarity scores did the Real-to-Real2 comparison yield across the second-, third-, and fourth-layer encoders, and what did the authors conclude from them?
What similarity scores did the Real-to-CwD comparison yield, and what does the paper conclude about the CwD approach's ability to bridge the Sim2Real gap?
How did the Real-to-Random-Data similarity scores compare to the other datasets in this study?
In this paper's Crow-AMSAA reliability growth model, what does a larger empirical constant α imply about an AV system's early-phase failure rate?
What characterizes 'Stage 2 (Revenue Service Deployment)' in this paper's AV deployment timeline model?
Why do consumer-focused AV categories (consumer automotive, robo-taxis) require longer timeline horizons in this paper's analysis?
What detector do the authors fine-tune for Stage 1 3D detection, and how large is the manually annotated roadside LiDAR dataset it was trained on?
How much does the joint detection-and-tracking design increase inference latency over a detection-only model, and on what GPU was this measured?
What does this paper conclude about how its proposed IECBF compares to a classical ECBF that neglects surrounding-vehicle reactions?
What model does the nominal IECBF assume for the surrounding vehicle (SV), and how can real SV behavior deviate from that assumption?
What is TrajFlow's main mechanism for avoiding the repetitive i.i.d. sampling required by conventional generative motion-prediction models?
What share of the surveyed critical-scenario-identification (CSI) methods focus on producing test cases for the AD system verification phase?
How did the authors of SAVeD source candidate videos before manual review and trimming?
What is claimed as novel about the SAVeD dataset relative to prior ADAS crash/near-miss data?
